in_sanskrit.name: नागेन्द्र

In Hindu mythology, Nagas are powerful deities that possess divine wisdom and have the ability to protect and bestow blessings upon their followers. The name Nagendr is not only a testament to one's heritage but also a source of inspiration and strength. It is a popular choice among Hindus and is still used today, making it a timeless and relevant name for any individual seeking to connect with their spiritual roots.
